rule: SPY decision close strictly above simple mean of the 200 contiguous XNYS closes ending on that decision: 75% equal-weight momentum and 25% cash; otherwise 100% cash
decision_timing: Evaluate once at each original rebalance close. Apply at the next scheduled open, never at the signal close. No mid-holding-window change or portfolio drawdown stop
missing_market_data: Fail the experiment on incomplete, conflicting-identity or invalid market history; do not substitute a risk-off signal
holding_rule: Reuse exactly the saved 21-session fixed-share portfolio path when risk-on. Hold cash at 0% when risk-off. No rescoring, constituent change, or delayed re-entry within the window
source_cutoff: Use each original sample's storage cutoff for all SPY closes, not latest data
cost_treatment: Reuse the existing 75% portfolio's exposure-scaled round-trip costs when risk-on; zero trading cost for a cash-only window. Prior positions are already liquidated and charged at the preceding scheduled exit
missing_path_treatment: Preserve the previous assumed paths for unresolved positions when risk-on. Cash-only windows have no unresolved invested weight; retain their underlying counts for disclosure
assessment: Development, later and full-history views in both samples, across all previously declared costs and missing-return scenarios. Report return retained, risk-on participation, cash periods and drawdown; no automatic certification from meeting the target
limitations: Same historical dates were examined previously; this is not an untouched holdout
SMA200 and 75/0 exposures are fixed before this run, not tuned to achieve 20%
Scheduled decisions can react slowly to fast losses and may miss recoveries
Daily paths with unresolved prices remain scenario estimates; daily closes omit intraday extremes
Price-return diagnostic excludes dividends, cash yield, realistic variable slippage and detailed settlement
No minimum return-retention requirement has been agreed; report tradeoffs without inventing a pass criterion
No strategy is published or orders placed
